description: Get a short-lived HTTPS link to PUT ONE file into the sandbox at `path` (up to 2 GB): `curl -fT <file> <url>`. One request carries at most 95 MB — for bigger files PUT parts in order with `?offset=<bytes already uploaded>` (each response returns `next_offset`; offset 0 overwrites). No base64 through this conversation. Requires: token + live sandbox_id. ≤95 MB per PUT; use ?offset for more.

max_bytes.description: Optional. Maximum size of the uploaded file in bytes, integer 1–2147483648 (2 GB). Default: the server limit (2 GB).

path.description: Required. Absolute path inside the sandbox to write the uploaded file to (overwritten at offset 0), e.g. "/root/app/main.py". Must start with "/".

sandbox_id.description: Required. Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

ttl.description: Optional. Link lifetime in seconds, 60–3600 (default 900 = 15 min).

name: get_upload_url
title: Upload link into a sandbox
